reasoning: 17.1.2（MPB1.2）規定預設檢視為第一個 preset bank。「預設」需以可控方式建立：先翻到非第一個 bank，離開 Playing Tab 再回來，確認回到第一個 bank——若只在剛開機時讀一次，無法區分「預設是第一個 bank」與「剛好停在第一個 bank」。ER 以 bank 內的 preset 內容判定而非頁碼指示器，因為 spec 未規定 bank 的頁碼呈現方式。容器錨定：ch17 全部條文都描述 Playing Tab 上的 Mixed Presets Bank，故每行 ER 指名該容器，與 ch16 PRE2.x 的 Browse Presets List、ch18 的 Presets Pop up 明確區隔——三者的 preset 外觀相近但欄位與控制項不同。優先級：屬進入畫面的落點行為，訂 P2。

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the first preset bank as the default preset bank view.

(First bank shown on re-entering the Playing Tab)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. More preset banks than one are configured by the Presets Shown indicator
3. The first and second preset banks each hold at least one distinguishable stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Record the stations displayed in the Mixed Presets Bank on the Playing Tab
4. Press the ">" button to display the next preset bank and read the stations displayed in the Mixed Presets Bank
5. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons, then press "Playing" to return to the Playing Tab, and read the stations displayed in the Mixed Presets Bank
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The stations of the first preset bank are displayed and recorded
4. The stations displayed differ from the stations recorded in step 3
5. The stations recorded in step 3 are displayed again in the Mixed Presets Bank
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
